test.description: Unit tests only — jest.config.cjs testRegex excludes src/e2e/**.

tests:e2e.description: Docker-based e2e (jest.e2e.config.cjs, global-setup starts bensyne compose with the locally-built bensyne-mcp image from `npx nx run bensyne-mcp:build:docker`). Includes the moved mcp-protocol suite (venv-python server, no Docker dependency).

build:docker.description: Build the tuiteraz/racochu Docker image. The tag is extracted at run time from apps/racochu/package.json ("version": "x.y.z") via an inline node -e read — same mechanism as bensyne-mcp's build:docker.

options.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version;if(!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(m||'')){console.error('no semver version in package.json');process.exit(1)};console.log(m)" > /tmp/racochu-version.txt && VERSION=$(cat /tmp/racochu-version.txt) && docker build -t tuiteraz/racochu:${VERSION} .

start.description: Run the compiled dist entrypoint (node dist/src/main.js). Resolves config to the global ~/.config/racochu.yaml unless -c/--config or APP_CONFIG_PATH is set.

start:dev.description: Run via nodemon (ts-node dev loop) with the local dev config: APP_CONFIG_PATH=dev.yaml is set ONLY by the start:dev script, never in .env.

start:docker.description: Run the tuiteraz/racochu image (tag from package.json). Racochu is a file-watcher CLI with no HTTP server — there is no request to answer; the most useful smoke is verifying the built entrypoint loads and the process stays alive. Exact invocation: docker run -d --name racochu-smoke -v <tmpdir>:/data/racochu tuiteraz/racochu:<version>; verify via docker inspect (Running) + logs, then docker rm -f racochu-smoke.

options.command: VERSION=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version;if(!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(m||'')){console.error('no semver version in package.json');process.exit(1)};console.log(m)") && TMPDIR_DATA=$(mktemp -d /tmp/racochu-data-XXXXXX) && docker rm -f racochu-smoke 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name racochu-smoke -v ${TMPDIR_DATA}:/data/racochu tuiteraz/racochu:${VERSION}

bump-version.description: Bump the app version per Conventional Commits by scanning commit subjects since the last commit touching apps/racochu/package.json (BREAKING CHANGE or type! -> major, feat -> minor, else patch). Shared script: scripts/bump-version.mjs (package.json + package-lock.json sync). CLI: node scripts/bump-version.mjs --app <appRoot> [--version-file <file>] [--dry-run].

data:wipe.description: Delete all files in the data folder (racochu.db, etc.)
